text:
maya: Heads-up: planning to publish Python + TS SDK during tonight's change window at 23:00 UTC. Main change: remove legacy sync client API surface. We will ship a compatibility shim for a short transition and include migration guidance. Need agreement on dist-tag hold window and rollback criteria.

samir: Quick q: are we doing a major version bump for Python? breaking public consumer surface?

maya: Python: public API will be marked deprecated (import-time warning) and shim present for one release cycle. We're keeping semver minor for now to ease upgrades but the next major will remove shim. TS: non-breaking rename of an export (we'll provide alias).

leo: Can we see the deprecation blurb you'll put in CHANGELOG/Release Notes? Also want canary results before we tag.

maya: Deprecation blurb: 
```
Deprecated: the legacy synchronous client is deprecated and scheduled for removal in the next major release (target removal date: 2026-05-15). Please migrate to the async client; a temporary compatibility shim is included in this release to help with migration.
```

deploy-bot: canary-run: canary-77 started -> smoke checks running.

ci-bot: matrix: 6/8 green, failures in matrix-job-3 (`test_refresh_token_edge`) — retrying (1/2).

anita: If that auth test keeps flaking, request we hold the dist-tag for 72h rather than 48h. Also we should add a short migration snippet and an FAQ entry in support docs.

samir: Proposed rollout: 10% for 45m -> 30% for 90m -> full. Health gates: error rate above 0.8% OR p95 latency +20% from baseline -> rollback. Escalation: ping oncall and exec after first 2 failed gates.

maya: That works. For holdback we plan: npm tag `holdback` + PyPI `holdback` via twine (don't set `latest` yet). Concierge teams should not auto-upgrade during hold window.

leo: Publish commands I'll run (dry-run first):
```
# python
python -m build && twine check dist/* && twine upload --repository pypi --non-interactive dist/* --comment "holdback"
# npm
npm publish --tag holdback
```

maya: Checklist: 
- finalize CHANGELOG + migration example (maya)
- validate canary and matrix green (leo + ci-bot)
- publish with `holdback` tag, then promote to `latest` after hold window (leo)
- draft support FAQ + canned responses (anita)
- monitor cohort metrics and rollback if thresholds hit (samir)

anita: I'll create the FAQ doc and a short snippet for common migration errors (import errors, typing issues). Also prepping support routing for the 23:00 window.

deploy-bot: canary-run: canary-77 smoke passed, perf checks show p95 within 8% of baseline. matrix job retries scheduled.

ci-bot: matrix-job-3 retry passed on attempt 2 -> marking green. All matrix jobs green now.

samir: Given green builds, I still prefer 72h holdback. Real-world customers upgrade unpredictably; the longer hold lets us catch any slow-failure regressions. If we see no issues we can promote to `latest` at 72h.

leo: Fine with 72h. I'll do a dry-run publish in ~10m then run the real publish at 23:05 UTC assuming no further issues. Will keep this thread updated.

maya: Rollback plan if needed: revert tag + re-publish previous artifact with patch fix (vX.Y.Z -> vX.Y.Z+1) and immediately set `latest` to previous stable. For npm yanks follow repo playbook; for PyPI use twine to re-upload previous wheel with new patch. Notify customers via release notes and support channel.

samir: One addition: telemetry flag to force routing to old runtime for affected orgs if we detect critical errors in production. Ops team aware.

leo: Dry-run complete, artifacts look good. Will run real publish at T+10 and add `holdback` tag. Please avoid auto-merging any release-note PRs that change the deprecation blurb before publish.

maya: Pushed final CHANGELOG and migration examples. PR #4321 merged.

deploy-bot: publish-queue: job 11023 scheduled for 23:05 UTC.

ci-bot: post-publish smoke job will run automatically; will report here.

anita: Support templates ready, routing key set, and oncall paged for the window.

leo: Publish completed. npm @holdback tag and PyPI holdback upload succeeded. Not promoting to `latest`.

deploy-bot: rollout: cohort 10% (00:45) -> 30% (01:30) -> 100% if gates pass.

samir: Monitoring live. Looking at error rate and p95. Thresholds set in dashboard.

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in this thread if any rollback decision needed. If no issues, schedule promotion to `latest` after 72h hold.

ci-bot: post-publish smoke: green.

leo: All quiet for now. Will keep watch and post final promote note in 72h if clean.

maya: Closing checklist: all items done except promote to `latest`. Will reopen this thread if anything changes.
